SPP_SYSTEM.description: Regional temperature proxy for the current aggregate SPP load dataset. Change these points and weights when using a validated location.

spp-wichita-demo.description: Temperature proxy at Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport, Wichita, KS used for illustrative Wichita data center interconnection modeling.

spp-oklahoma-city-demo.description: Temperature proxy at Will Rogers World Airport, Oklahoma City, OK used for illustrative Oklahoma City data center interconnection modeling.

spp-lincoln-demo.description: Temperature proxy at Lincoln Airport, Lincoln, NE used for illustrative Lincoln data center interconnection modeling.
